name: New York Times
outlook:
What New York Times says to expect

  • Full year 2026: cash tax paymentsThe Company expects lower cash tax payments of approximately $60 million in total for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026, and does not expect the majority of this cash flow benefit to recur beyond fiscal 2026.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresThe Company expects the following on a pre-tax basis in 2026: • Depreciation and amortization: approximately $85 million, which includes approximately $25-$30 million of acquired intangible assets amortization, • Interest income and other, net: approximately $45-$50 million, and • Capital expenditures: approximately $35-$40 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
